claims.claim: The possible edge may come from adherence rather than physiology: some people find fasting easier to stick to.

citations.quote: Not for weight loss itself. In the 2026 Clinical Nutrition trial and in earlier randomized studies, intermittent fasting and calorie counting produced very similar weight loss. Where fasting may have an edge is adherence — some people find it less mentally demanding because they don’t have to track every calorie, and easier adherence can mean better long-term results.
